Remaining animals: bee, butterfly, ant, spider. I want a question that splits them as evenly as possible.

"Can it fly?" yes for bee and butterfly, no for ant and spider, so it splits 2/2. Each outcome still leaves two animals, so I would need one more question and then a guess.

A question that isolates a single animal is only slightly better, because a wrong answer still leaves three. Another option is "Is it an insect?", which leaves 3 vs 1 (spider alone), so the 2/2 split is better.

After a 2/2 split I would guess directly, with a 50% chance of being right, and the second guess would settle it. Expected turns are about the same either way, so I'll take the flying question.
